system.name: Autonomy-Adaptive Voltage Scaling (AAVS)
system.one_liner: an entropy-predictor-driven voltage scaling subsystem that adjusts an embodied-AI controller's supply voltage in real time

components.name: CNN
components.role: processes the observed image through Conv2d/ReLU/MaxPool2d and Conv2d/ReLU/AvgPool2d stages

components.name: Fusion
components.role: combines CNN and MLP feature outputs

components.name: Dropout
components.role: regularization before the final entropy prediction

components.name: Pred Entropy
components.role: the predicted error-free entropy output of the network

components.name: Entropy Predictor
components.role: pre-execution predictor estimating the controller's error-free entropy from subtask prompt and observed image, running at nominal voltage

components.name: LDO
components.role: digital low-dropout regulator that converts the predicted entropy into an operating-voltage adjustment

components.name: Controller (RL)
components.role: the RL-based controller model running on PE arrays, whose supply voltage (VDD) is set by the LDO

content.key_idea: a lightweight CNN+MLP entropy predictor, kept at nominal voltage for accuracy, estimates the controller's per-step entropy so an LDO can scale the controller's PE-array voltage down during non-critical, high-entropy steps and up during critical, low-entropy steps
content.reading_order: panel (a) top-down: subtask prompt and observed image through CNN/MLP branches, fused and reduced to Pred Entropy; panel (b) left-right: predictor output drives the LDO, which sets the Controller (RL) PE array's VDD to produce an action

summary: This figure details CREATE's autonomy-adaptive voltage scaling (AAVS) subsystem. Panel (a) shows the entropy predictor's network architecture: a CNN (with two Conv2d/ReLU/pooling blocks) processes the observed image while an MLP processes the subtask prompt embedding; their outputs are fused, passed through ReLU and Dropout, and reduced to a predicted entropy value. Panel (b) shows how this prediction is used at the system level: the subtask prompt and observed image feed the Entropy Predictor, whose real-time entropy estimate drives a digital LDO, which in turn sets the supply voltage (VDD) of the Controller (RL) PE array that produces the next action. The predictor itself runs at nominal voltage to keep its estimate error-free, while the controller's voltage is scaled based on that estimate -- lower for high-entropy (non-critical) steps and higher for low-entropy (critical) steps.
summary_zh: 该图展示CREATE的自适应电压调节子系统：(a) 熵预测器架构，CNN处理观测图像、MLP处理子任务提示，融合后经ReLU、Dropout输出预测熵；(b) 系统级电压调节回路，预测熵驱动LDO实时调整控制器PE阵列的供电电压VDD，进而生成动作，预测器本身在标称电压下运行以保证精度。
